title: Cambium: the fractal operating ecosystem
job: Explain how project identity, skill ownership, workflow gates, and evidence compose into a safe Moosh path.
watcher: A project owner or operator deciding whether to approve evidence capture.

shots.see: Project identity anchors every downstream projection.
shots.why: Without a root, a skill or plan cannot be safely scoped.
shots.get: A clear boundary for every later action.
shots.vo: Start with the project boundary: identity is the first safety mechanism.

shots.see: GSD and next-wave planning map intent into work.
shots.why: A mapped wave gives operators a shared shape for the work.
shots.get: Coordination without mistaking a plan for execution.
shots.vo: Planning gives the work a shape, while the runtime still decides what is real.

shots.see: Two hubs resolve ownership before two Moosh spokes act.
shots.why: Ownership prevents a guide task from jumping to the wrong capability.
shots.get: A guide-first route with clear boundaries.
shots.vo: The cluster resolves who owns the work before the work can move.

shots.see: Read-only inspection leads to gated evidence and downstream validation.
shots.why: Each stage makes its prerequisites visible before the next one begins.
shots.get: A predictable path that fails closed when evidence is missing.
shots.vo: The workflow is a sequence of gates: observe, resolve, prepare, prove, compose, validate.

shots.see: A bounded local route and synthetic persona define the capture envelope.
shots.why: A configuration file is preparation, not proof that capture occurred.
shots.get: Evidence that can be checked, reproduced, and attributed.
shots.vo: The capture envelope stays small so the resulting evidence stays trustworthy.

shots.see: The trigger remains disabled until a matching receipt exists.
shots.why: Evidence-producing work belongs to an explicit owner decision.
shots.get: A truthful next action: approve, then request, then validate.
shots.vo: Cambium stops at the approval boundary, preserving a truthful record of what has and has not run.

cta: Review the gates, approve only the bounded run you intend, and validate its evidence.
